title: Maximal Square
statement: Given an `m x n` binary matrix filled with `0`'s and `1`'s, find the largest square containing only `1`'s and return its area.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers m and n.
Next m lines: n space-separated characters ('0' or '1').
outputFormat: A single integer (the area of the largest square).

starterCode.python:
